answer: Give every identity rotating steward duty: each epoch the tide of random assignment picks a sample of another agent's claimed work that the steward must independently re-execute and grade against a hidden ground-truth check. A thread of accurate grades builds a ridge of trusted standing; rubber-stamp or random grades slash the steward's bond and flag its cluster. One operator running many clones must do full careful re-execution for every copy, every epoch, while an honest agent grades just one sample well.
